title: Bear in Ancient Ruins
description: A large gray bear with detailed fur leans over a weathered stone table covered in broken map fragments. The bear's paw rests on the map while a dramatic beam of light shines down from above, illuminating the scene against a backdrop of vine-covered stone ruins and a lit lantern in a crumbling wall niche.
prompt: A majestic gray bear with rich textured fur stands at a broken ancient stone table in overgrown temple ruins, one paw resting on scattered pieces of an old map. Dramatic volumetric light beam cuts through the darkness from above, illuminating the bear and table. Vines cover weathered stone pillars and walls, small stone lantern nearby, warm light glowing from a wall sconce in the background, highly detailed digital painting.
